title: Researchers train AI to detect concealed handguns using Wi-Fi signals — open-source WiFireNet achieves precision detection on older 802.11a standard by analyzing how weapons distort wireless signals
hook_text: Wi-Fi signals just learned to find guns.
script:
An open-source AI called WiFireNet spots concealed handguns by tracking wireless disturbances.
It works by analyzing how metal objects distort wireless signals bouncing between routers.
Researchers specifically trained the detection model on the older 802.11a wireless standard.
The software achieves precision weapon detection without needing expensive security camera setups.
Building security teams could soon screen crowds using existing router hardware instead of new gear.
Would you trust a router to spot a weapon?
